warnings: Complete the FULL course even if you feel better by day 2–3
Stop and seek help immediately for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
Not effective against viral colds/flu
tips: Take after food
Space doses evenly across the day
Probiotic curd/yogurt may ease stomach upset

data.name: Pan-D
data.uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Supplementation of the diet with vitamins A, C and D. Tri-Vite Drops with Fluoride 0.25 mg also provides fluoride for caries prophylaxis. The American Academy of Pediatrics recommends that children up to age 16, in areas where drinking water contains less than optimal levels of fluoride, receive daily fluoride supplementation.
data.usesPlain: It strongly reduces stomach acid, relieving heartburn and protecting your stomach lining.
data.howItWorks: Switches off the acid pumps in stomach cells.
warnings: Best taken 30–60 minutes BEFORE breakfast
Long-term daily use should be reviewed by your doctor
tips: Empty-stomach timing matters for full effect
Avoid late-night heavy meals
